Artist.value: Raja Ravi Varma

ImageDescription.value: Childhood of Saravadamana is depicted in this Picture. Sarvadamana was the son of Dushyanta and Sankuntala. Sarvadamana later become Emperor Bharata (Sanskrit: भरतः). He is the first to conquer all of Greater India, uniting it into a single entity which was named after him as Bhāratavarṣa.
